blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Police are hunting two motorcycle-riding suspects who allegedly hurled stones at a 10-wheeler truck early Sunday here, leaving its driver with a serious eye injury. Maj. Carmelo Malubay, San Francisco police chief, said investigators were coordinating with authorities in neighboring Rosario town after receiving leads that the suspects fled in that direction. The attack occurred in Purok 5, Barangay Pasta. The driver was caught off guard and could not identify the assailants, who sped away on a motorcycle.
